scope: Run 6 (docs/evidence/step-9/s9-2/result-f.json) read back from the saved runner and database reads of S9.2f, the
processor container's request log, and ulpin-reh-25 read with default_transaction_read_only on. Seconds are from
the Add press; database times are row and event times (a row's time is its transaction's start). No code change.

runtime.name: ulpin-reh-25
runtime.started: exit 0 (platform:start --profile demo --runtime ulpin-reh-25; doctor all passed, gateway disabled)
runtime.stopped: exit 0 (platform:stop --profile demo --runtime ulpin-reh-25), volumes and folder kept

processorAnswer: 5.932 s is the answer, not the request start: the processor's convert-native route is a synchronous handler that
returns the whole conversion as one JSON body, and uvicorn writes its access line when that response is sent.
The request started after the claim at 3.242 s, so the processor took at most 2.69 s.
timeline: first keep: no kept child, case revision read, receipt create refused UPLOAD_QUOTA (no row is left)
parent words written: converted and waiting for a free upload slot (runner saw them at 7.607)
the case's v1 receipts free again (documents-and-plans-pdf-small-1 retained); the wait is not woken
the slot wait's 30 s timer ends (derived from the refusal at about 5.95 s)
its one part received and stored; receipt finalizing
receipt sealed: layer kept as its own retained original (case revision 14)
register: intake item created (prepare transaction start)
register: probe published, layer item probed, first intake-large step queued

slotRefusal.limit: open_receipts_case (v1: 2 open receipts per case; the operator cap is also 2, global 4)
heldThen: documents-and-plans-pdf-small-1: receiving from 5.417 s, finalizing 6.570 s, retained 6.784 s
documents-and-plans-pdf-small-2: its retain transaction started 5.527 s; inferred still uncommitted at about
5.95 s, as only these two receipts were open in the case and no other case had any open receipt
slotRefusal.note: 3D-models-gml-medium-1's receipt was created at 6.104 s, after the refusal; no receipt row was left open.

waitedOn: the upload slot wait: large-original.ts waitForUploadSlot wakes on a slot freed in its own process
(slotsChanged) or after 30 s; the browser's receipts finalize in the API process, so the dispatcher's
keepWhenSlotFree slept the full 30 s although the case's slots were free from 6.784 s; freesAt was the
IntakeService.register between its prepare transaction (case FOR UPDATE) and its publish transaction: the
prepare's lock wait and the probe of the layer's head. Not named by any stored row; no lock wait over 5 s was
sampled in the window and the processor saw no request; the dispatcher's event loop was running CSV streaming
and mapping, the workbook draft and the large raster's v2 receipt in process. The medium layer's same step

smallModel.underTwoSeconds: processor at most 2.69 s; receipt 0.63 s; register prepare 0.67 s; parent words 1.46 s

staleNativeRead.job: citygml-native queued 1.198 s beside the conversion, ended stale at 4.974 s before any claim
staleNativeRead.movedPin: caseContextSha256 only (case revision is not compared; source, access, reader and tools unchanged)
why: The pinned hash equals the case's current frame and context with no site; the current hash equals the same
frame and context with the case's site. The case was bound to a site between 1.198 s and 4.974 s.
movingWrite: Another file: areas.ts bindRetainedCaseTx (UPDATE cases SET site_id), run when a part is saved into an area.
The only job that ended in that window was imagery-and-point-clouds-tif-small-1's raster window (claimed
1.190 s, completed 3.120 s); the conversion queued beside the read pins no case context and wrote only item
words. The file is inferred from timing: the site_id write is not stored with a time.
staleNativeRead.cost: re-queued at 4.974 s, claimed 6.509 s; the read is beside the map path (the conversion feeds the map)

waitedOn: the one-per-process rule for in-process operations: dispatch-lanes.ts DispatchReservations
unavailableOperations makes every in-process operation outside its parallel list a singleton, and
intake-native-derivative is not in that list. The small model's conversion held it from 3.242 s to 46.691 s
(30.65 s of it asleep in the slot wait); the medium's was claimed 0.60 s after it ended
ruledOut: vector lane full: only that one conversion held a vector slot (6 allowed)
memory or heap refusal: one 512 MiB hold in the lane, no older refused job ahead
a fence or the item busy rule: one attempt, no stale or failed end; the busy rule applies to intake-large only

waitedOn: the conversion itself; no queue in the processor: its only other requests then were three short calls
(49.7, 66.3, 67.0 s) and no second convert-native. It ran beside the medium's own CityGML native read of the
same original (host reader, 24.633 to 71.185 s) and the large raster's v2 receipt assembly (39.6 to 68.1 s);
run 5's same conversion took 21.37 s. The processor logs no phase times to split fetch, read and write

mediumModel.afterAnswer: receipt 74.956 to 75.288 s, layer kept 75.473 s, probed 75.563 s, job done 75.755 s; no slot wait

change: large-original.ts waitForUploadSlot: wake at the earliest of 2 s, freesAt and the deadline instead of 30 s,
so a slot freed by the API process is seen within 2 s
changes.secondsSaved: about 28 per derivative layer that meets a full case (small model: about 28)

list, so two conversions may run in one dispatcher under the vector lane, memory and heap admission
changes.secondsSaved: up to 28.5 for the second model (with the first change alone its wait would be about 13)
changes.risk: medium-low: two conversions' 1 MiB copy streams and receipts at once; the conversion runs in the processor
